title: CIRP commencement / IRP appointment
mandate: Insolvency commencement date recorded in NCLT admission order

title: Issue public announcement (Form A)
mandate: Within 3 days of appointment of IRP

title: Last date for initial claims in public announcement
mandate: 14 days from appointment of IRP as stated in Form A; check current regulation and announcement
kind: Statutory trigger; date calculated from appointment

title: Verify claims received
mandate: Within 7 days of receipt of each claim; not a single universal T+21 deadline

title: Application for appointment of Authorised Representative, if applicable
mandate: Track from verification of claims / applicable trigger under Regulation 16A

title: File report certifying CoC constitution
mandate: Within 2 days of verification of claims, subject to the applicable rule

title: First CoC meeting
mandate: Within 7 days of filing CoC constitution report; notice requirements also apply

title: CoC decision on appointment / replacement of RP
mandate: At first CoC meeting; appointment process must follow Code and regulations

title: AA approval of RP appointment
mandate: Enter actual AA order date; not a fixed T+ date

title: IRP continues to perform RP functions if no RP appointed
mandate: Track continuation until RP is appointed; T+40 is an alert benchmark, not a substitute for the regulation

title: Appoint two registered valuers
mandate: Within 7 days of appointment of RP (confirm current text and case facts); calculate from actual RP appointment

title: Prepare and share Information Memorandum with CoC
mandate: Within 2 weeks of RP appointment and not later than the 54th day of commencement under the applicable text

title: Publish invitation for Expression of Interest (Form G)
mandate: Use current consolidated Regulation 36A and Form G circular; do not rely on legacy T+60/T+75 alone without checking applicability

title: Last date for EoI submission
mandate: Calculate from actual publication date and the minimum period required by current Regulation 36A

title: Issue provisional list of prospective resolution applicants
mandate: Calculate from actual last date for EoI under current Regulation 36A

title: Invite objections to provisional list
mandate: Apply the period in current Regulation 36A from actual provisional-list publication

title: Issue final list of prospective resolution applicants
mandate: Calculate using actual objections deadline and current Regulation 36A

title: Issue RFRP, evaluation matrix and IM to eligible RAs
mandate: Calculate from the applicable list/event and current Regulation 36B

title: Form opinion on avoidance / PUFE transactions
mandate: On or before day 75 of insolvency commencement date, subject to applicable current text

title: Determine whether avoidance / PUFE transactions occurred
mandate: On or before day 115 of insolvency commencement date, subject to applicable current text

title: File applications for appropriate relief on avoidance / PUFE transactions
mandate: On or before day 135 of insolvency commencement date, subject to applicable current text

title: Last date for receipt of resolution plans
mandate: Provide at least the minimum period required by current Regulation 36B from actual RFRP issue date

title: Submit CoC-approved plan and compliance certificate (Form H) to AA
mandate: File as required by current Regulation 39(4); Form H format notified by IBBI circular dated 2 June 2026

title: CIRP completion / AA decision on resolution plan
mandate: 180 days is a base statutory period; extensions, exclusions, amendment transition and court orders must be checked

title: Late claims / claims not included in initial announcement
mandate: Check current Regulation 12(2), the actual circumstances, and applicable AA directions before setting a date

title: Check operational creditor representation in CoC
mandate: Amended rule refers to largest unrelated operational creditors; if fewer than 18 such unrelated operational creditors, include all such unrelated operational creditors

title: Invite operational creditor observers where non-bank/PFI creditors hold >66% voting share
mandate: RP to invite five largest unrelated operational creditors, including three largest statutory-dues authorities by admitted claim value, as observers without voting rights; record observations in minutes

title: Place pre-first-meeting CIRP costs with justification before CoC
mandate: All CIRP costs incurred up to first CoC meeting and justification must be placed for approval at first meeting

title: Prepare and present Going Concern Assessment Report
mandate: Include estimated income, expenditure and cash flows; working capital needs; material value-erosion risks; CoC decides continuation, scope and duration of operations

title: Obtain prior CoC approval for post-first-meeting CIRP costs
mandate: At each CoC meeting present next-period estimates, seek approval for proposed costs, and compare actual costs with previously approved estimates

title: Document CoC evaluation of resolution plans
mandate: Record reasoning on feasibility/viability, expected creditor recoveries versus fair/liquidation value, and adequacy of market discovery including challenge / re-invitation where applicable

title: Consider two-stage approval route where applicable
mandate: Form GA for application for two-stage approval of resolution plan is notified in IBBI Circular IBBI/CIRP/94/2026 dated 2 June 2026; use only where route applies

title: Use current notified Form H for compliance certificate
mandate: IBBI Circular IBBI/CIRP/94/2026 dated 2 June 2026 specifies Form H under Regulation 39(4); check current instructions and annexures before filing

title: Maintain filing and reporting calendar for CIRP forms
mandate: Check current reporting forms, modification utility, due dates and applicable fee / late-filing consequences on official IBBI portal
timeline: As each reporting form falls due

title: Reconcile IM, Form G, provisional/final lists and RFRP against actual case events
mandate: This row is a control check to prevent legacy hard-coded T+ assumptions from overriding current regulation and event dates
